grammar.title: First / second conditional
grammar.form: If + present simple, will/can/may + base verb

explanation.en: First conditional: a real or possible future outcome.
explanation.vi: Loại 1: điều kiện có khả năng xảy ra trong tương lai.

grammar.example: If the weather improves, the parade will take place outside.

grammar.title: First / second conditional
grammar.form: If + past simple, would/could/might + base verb

explanation.en: Second conditional: imagined, unlikely or unreal present/future. Use were in formal hypothetical statements.
explanation.vi: Loại 2: tình huống giả định/ít khả năng ở hiện tại hoặc tương lai; văn trang trọng dùng were.

grammar.example: If I were the organiser, I would limit plastic waste.

strategies.en: Ask: does the speaker view it as a genuine future possibility or an imagined alternative? Only then choose the verb form.
strategies.vi: Tự hỏi: đây là khả năng thực tế hay giả định tưởng tượng? Sau đó mới chia động từ.

common_mistakes.wrong: If I will go tomorrow, I will take photos.
common_mistakes.correct: If I go tomorrow, I will take photos.

reason.en: The if-clause of a normal first conditional uses present simple.
reason.vi: Mệnh đề if loại 1 dùng hiện tại đơn.

passages.title: When a village festival becomes famous
passages.text:
[A] For more than three hundred years, the people of the fictional mountain village of San Morel have celebrated the end of the harvest with a festival of light. On the first night of the full moon in October, every household places paper lanterns along the narrow streets, and the villagers walk in a slow procession to the old stone bridge, where the lanterns are released onto the river. For most of its history, the festival was attended only by villagers and a few relatives from nearby towns.

[B] That changed about fifteen years ago, when a travel photographer published a series of pictures of the procession. The images were shared widely online, and within three years the number of visitors on festival night had grown from a few hundred to more than twenty thousand. Hotels, cafés and souvenir shops opened in a village that had previously had a single guest house, and many young people who had moved to the city for work returned to run businesses.

[C] For the local economy, the effect has been largely positive. The village council estimates that tourism now provides around a third of all local income, and the population, which had been falling for decades, has begun to grow again. The primary school, which was close to closing because of a lack of pupils, has added a new classroom. Several traditional crafts, including lantern making and wood carving, have been revived because there is now a market for them.

[D] Yet many residents feel that the festival has lost something important. The procession, which used to move slowly and quietly, is now surrounded by crowds holding up phones, and some visitors push into the procession to take photographs. Older villagers complain that the ceremony at the bridge, which has a religious meaning for many families, has become a show for outsiders. In a survey carried out by the council, a majority of residents said they were proud that people came to see the festival, but almost as many said they no longer enjoyed taking part.

[E] There are also practical problems. The narrow streets were never designed for thousands of people, and in some years the crowds have been so large that emergency vehicles could not get through. The river below the bridge is now filled with lanterns, many of them cheap plastic versions sold to tourists, which take months to break down and harm fish. Local volunteers spend several days after the festival removing rubbish from the riverbanks.

[F] The council has introduced a number of changes in response. Since last year, visitors must book a free ticket online, and the number of tickets is limited to eight thousand. Only lanterns made from paper and natural materials may be released into the river, and these are sold by local craftspeople. A separate viewing area has been built on a hillside above the village, so that visitors can watch the procession without entering the narrowest streets.

[G] These measures have had mixed results. Residents report that the procession feels calmer, and the amount of rubbish in the river has fallen considerably. However, some business owners complain that their income has dropped, and a number of visitors who arrived without tickets were angry when they were turned away. There have also been reports of tickets being resold online at high prices, despite being free.

[H] San Morel’s experience is far from unique. Around the world, small communities are discovering that a tradition which once belonged to them alone can quickly become an attraction for thousands. The challenge is to share it without destroying the qualities that made it worth visiting. Some villagers believe the answer is to hold a second, private ceremony for residents only, on the night after the public festival. That proposal will be discussed at the next village meeting.

coach.message: Bài “Conditionals and exam skill review”: Dùng câu điều kiện loại 1/2 đúng mục đích, vẫn phân biệt kiến thức Grammar và bằng chứng Reading. Trước khi thử, hãy nói một việc bạn sẽ kiểm tra ở bài này.

Bạn đang xem “first conditional” (noun phrase), nghĩa là “câu điều kiện loại 1”. Ví dụ: “The first conditional describes a possible future result.”. Hãy tạo một câu mới liên quan đến conditionals and exam skill review thay vì chép lại.

Ở ví dụ có hướng dẫn “Complete: If it ____ tomorrow, the parade will move indoors.”, hãy làm bước này trước: Separate grammar transformation from evidence-based interpretation. Chỉ mở mẫu sau khi tự thử.
Lỗi dễ gặp ở bài “Conditionals and exam skill review”: Không viết will rain trong mệnh đề if của cấu trúc này. Sau if dùng hiện tại đơn dù câu nói về tương lai.

Bạn đã hoàn thành bài “Conditionals and exam skill review”. Hãy đánh dấu bằng chứng trong văn bản; lưu cụm “first conditional” nếu thực sự muốn dùng lại, rồi sửa một chỗ chưa chắc chắn trước khi làm bài mới.
Bài này mình luyện Conditionals và review thông tin lễ hội. Hãy đọc đoạn rồi tìm phần nào trả lời đúng câu hỏi; chưa cần đoán ngay.
